evidence.excerpt:
- |
    **Added** support for warmup configuration in DestinationRule's LB trafficPolicy

    duration: specify the duration of warmup mode
    minimumPercent : specifies the initial percent of origin load
    aggression : will define the evolution of the % of traffic sent to the pods from minimumPercent to 100%

issue: Support agression and min_weight_percent in DestinationRule [closed; labels kind/enhancement, area/networking]
(This is used to request new product features, please visit <https://discuss.istio.io> for questions on using Istio)

**Describe the feature request**
We are using Java micro-services, which usually needs a warmup phase to have the best performance. After testing `warmupDurationSecs` on production it was not concluant, because of the `min_weight_percent` that is by default 10%. It is already too much for our service.

Indeed currently DestinationRules only support envoy's `slow…

host:app.svc.cluster.local
trafficPolicy:
loadBalancer:
warmupDurationSecs: 2
```

But the API is lacking `aggression` and `min_weight_percent` parameters (cf. [envoy doc](https://www.envoyproxy.io/docs/envoy/latest/intro/arch_overview/upstream/load_balancing/slow_start)) which are essentials in our context.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
